profiles.business_context: The team has received a compact evidence package and needs a review-ready conclusion with clear provenance.

evidence_to_deliverable.scenario_goal: Prepare a concise evidence-backed deliverable for manager review.
deliverable_requirements: summarize the evidence reviewed
state the conclusion supported by the evidence
flag unresolved exceptions or missing support

cross_check_validation.scenario_goal: Validate a business conclusion by cross-checking independent evidence paths.
deliverable_requirements: show independent checks used to validate the conclusion
separate matched, unmatched, and unresolved items
document judgment calls and follow-up needs

fan_in_reconciliation.scenario_goal: Reconcile multiple evidence sources into one review-ready workpaper.
deliverable_requirements: reconcile source totals to the requested reporting view
explain material differences
identify evidence gaps that affect confidence

policy_application.scenario_goal: Apply stated policy requirements to concrete evidence and document exceptions.
deliverable_requirements: identify the applicable policy or requirement
apply the rule to the provided cases
separate compliant, exception, and uncertain items

profiles.business_context: A warehouse team must verify inbound and outbound records, maintain accurate item and location balances, and document discrepancies for an operations supervisor.

fan_in_reconciliation.scenario_goal: Reconcile purchase, shipment, receiving, and location records into a review-ready inventory workpaper.
deliverable_requirements: reconcile expected and received quantities by shipment and item
separate matched, short, over, damaged, and unresolved records
show the resulting accepted inventory and location updates

cross_check_validation.scenario_goal: Validate item balances and storage locations by cross-checking independent movement records.
deliverable_requirements: recalculate ending quantity from opening, receipt, and issue movements
compare calculated balances with location records
document every unresolved difference with evidence IDs

policy_application.scenario_goal: Apply the provided receiving rules to shipment exceptions and prepare an actionable operations memo.
deliverable_requirements: classify shortages, overages, damage, wrong items, and location discrepancies
apply only the candidate-visible receiving rules
state the required hold, correction, escalation, or acceptance action
